item.tib: mdos kyi gnad gzhi mtshams bcad dang sna khrid rgyab ded 'gab mgyog sogs
item.coloph: mdos kyi gnad bzhi ni/ ci byed las kyi rno mdel yin/ 'di ni kun gyi spyi ching yin/ mdos kyi brgya chun cig zhes bya ba 'di ni/ g.ya' ma dmar po'i gter ma'o/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyis/ gsungs pa'i drag mdos bzhi 'di/ bcud dril nas gom du sbas/ phyi rabs las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog
